title: Four original freeform editorial compositions for Crystal Cobalt

pages.claim: A transition from scale to profitability
pages.silhouette: large asymmetric type with oversized refractive optical loop
pages.reason: An optical turning form expresses the strategic transition

pages.claim: A negative earnings starting point with balance metrics
pages.silhouette: monumental negative result on light page + inset dark vertical metrics rail
pages.graphicFamily: financial ledger with icy near-white surfaces
pages.reason: Readable separation between financial baseline and operational balance

pages.silhouette: three broad vertical initiative columns with bottom-aligned numeric impacts
pages.graphicFamily: semantic pictograms and prismatic faceted accent
pages.reason: Keeps initiatives aligned and emphasizes factual impact values

pages.claim: Choose priorities, capital constraints and execution ownership
pages.silhouette: asymmetric diagonal color wedge with a dimensional arrow and right briefing column
pages.graphicFamily: faceted arrow on mixed editorial panel
pages.reason: The arrow indicates choice and execution, not a claim about numeric growth
